name: factory
title_zh: 把 Claude Code 和 Codex 调教成同
tagline_zh: 别再让两个 AI 各干各的——用同一份参考实现，让它们产出同构的代码、同款的提交、同味的架构。
tagline_en: Stop letting two AIs drift apart—one reference implementation keeps Claude Code and Codex producing the same.
desc_en: A reference software factory for Claude Code and Codex
why_zh: 它把『软件工厂』的隐性约定——目录结构、命名、提交粒度——固化成可复制的模板，让多 Agent 协作不。
why_en: It bakes the unwritten rules of a software factory—layout, naming, commit granularity—into a copyable template, so multi-agent.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Claude Code 和 Codex 两个运行时；不含部署、CI/CD 或测试策略。若你的工具链不在其中。
limit_en: Only covers Claude Code and Codex runtimes; no deploy, CI/CD, or test strategy. Other toolchains must translate its conventions themselves or.
